architecture_payoff.current_failure_cost: Repeated user reminders, unnecessary architecture additions, and unsafe ambiguity around external mutation retries.
architecture_payoff.change_cost: One compatible maintenance-policy hardening, one meta-harness schema increment, one artifact-policy hardening, one narrow deterministic runtime and bounded tests.
architecture_payoff.expected_payoff: Fewer duplicate mechanisms and user questions, explicit deletion pressure, and safer cross-agent mutation retry behavior.
architecture_payoff.deletion_or_simplification_result: Reuse the existing maintenance and artifact authorities; do not add a Top10 policy, capability-acquisition agent, decision agent, or mutation policy.

instruction_surface.reason: The existing startup hook already routes systemic maintenance to repository authority. These primitives are enforceable in runtime/policy/harness and should not enlarge account or startup prompts.

propagation.mechanism: Operational-hygiene/evolution semantics become stricter through existing shared maintenance authority; artifact_io semantics gains OUTCOME_UNKNOWN retry safety without adding a new owner hook. No owner business state or lease is mutated by this promotion.

Payoff/deletion review reuses the existing complexity budget rather than creating a second architecture authority.
